project.name: NEVO 现代化 GUI 前端
project.designRead: VoIP desktop app / power users & admins / dark emerald professional security / medium-high density / avoid neon glow and purple gradients

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: emerald green for connection states, CTAs, and active channel indicators
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single emerald hue with no secondary/accent; categories use neutral or primary tints

styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + MiSans for body, JetBrains Mono for technical data
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-led cards with minimal shadow; floating layers use deeper shadow

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: client pages use Discord-style 3-column: server rail (72px) + channel sidebar (240px) + main content; server pages use left sidebar nav (220px) + main area with topbar
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single emerald primary; no secondary brand hue
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter/MiSans sans-serif body, JetBrains Mono for code/data
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-led card surfaces, shadow only for floating layers (modal, toast, dropdown)
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: rounded-md primary buttons with emerald fill, ghost buttons with border
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: tight spacing, dense information layout appropriate for communication tools

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Dark emerald theme for secure VoIP communication platform. Deep green-black backgrounds with emerald (#2DD4A8) primary. Professional, dense, communication-tool aesthetic.

pages.title: 连接服务器
pages.visualNorthStar: Focused connection form with subtle emerald glow around the primary input. Minimal distractions, one clear CTA. Server address field is the visual anchor.

pages.title: 主界面 — 语音频道
pages.visualNorthStar: Discord-style 3-column layout: slim server rail, channel tree sidebar with voice user indicators, main area with chat + voice panel. Voice activity indicators use animated emerald rings.

pages.title: 视频通话
pages.visualNorthStar: Immersive video call overlay with dark background, large video frames, floating control bar at bottom. Minimal chrome, maximum video surface. End call button in red.

pages.title: 服务端 — 仪表盘
pages.visualNorthStar: Admin dashboard with sidebar navigation, stat cards grid (online users, channels, packets, uptime), compact session/channel tables, and real-time system metrics with gauges.

pages.title: 服务端 — 会话管理
pages.visualNorthStar: Session management table with batch selection, user details, connection info, channel membership, and bulk kick actions. Clean table layout with status badges and action buttons.
